summary: AstraZeneca (foreign private issuer, Form 6-K) announced completion of a previously disclosed exclusive worldwide license agreement with Dizal Pharmaceutical for Zegfrovy (sunvozertinib), an oral EGFR inhibitor for non-small cell lung cancer. AstraZeneca acquired global rights to develop and commercialize the product, which is approved in the US and China for second-line treatment. Terms include a $600 million upfront cash payment, up to $900 million in development, regulatory, and sales milestones, and tiered royalties. The transaction does not affect AstraZeneca's 2026 financial guidance. Watch for regulatory progress on first-line supplemental applications and potential competitive landscape shifts.
